text:
Maya: Proposal: sliding-window commit smoothing for Dedicated customers to reduce overprovision during seasonal dips. TL;DR: compute 30-day rolling peak, apply buffer = clamp(10% + delta, 12%..35%) based on usage percentile. Draft config below. Looking for objections before PS review. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-820

Sam: Sounds interesting. How do we surface guarantees in contract? Customers expect fixed commit + burst. Need clear billing semantics and burst credit accounting. :thinking_face:

Jordan: Quick forecast note — historical Q4 spikes ~2.2-2.6x. With a 30d lookback smoothing and min 12% / max 35% buffer, coverage improves vs flat 20%:

```
30d_peak = max(rolling_window(30d, daily_peaks))
buffer = clamp(0.12, 0.35, 0.12 + 0.5*(current_usage/30d_peak))
```

Numbers: flat20 => 88% coverage, sliding => 93% coverage (18mo history)

Kevin: Cost side — preliminary calc: average infra spend down ~12% (less idle), but we still need short-term burst pool for simultaneous spikes. Model worst-case 72h ramp for capacity planning.

Leila: Ops concern: dynamic downsizing during cross-region flaps could cascade. Proposal: add safety circuit-breaker: if region error_rate > 3% OR loss_of_replica > 1 => freeze smoothing (hold buffer at current level) and send page. Also need manual override flag in console. (I'll draft runbook.)

OpsBot: metric snapshot (automated): 30d rolling GPU hrs: us-west-2=14200, eu-west-1=8100, ap-southeast-1=4100; 30d peak day: us-west-2=43000; current config buffer=20%; active commits=18.7k GPU hrs/month.

Maya: Updated config draft (WIP):

```yaml
smoothing:
  lookback_days: 30
  min_buffer: 0.12
  max_buffer: 0.35
  peak_percentile: 95
  freeze_conditions:
    - name: region_error_rate
      threshold: 0.03
    - name: replica_loss
      threshold: 1
```

Sam: We should simulate against KestrelAI and KuboWorks commits before sending to sales. Also need explicit burst-credit language: e.g., 20% baseline burst included, additional burst billed at on-demand rate.

Jordan: I'll run simulation for KestrelAI, KuboWorks, and an aggregate synthetic seasonal pattern. Will post graphs + CSV by EOD.

Kevin: Also flag: spot preemption risk increases effective cost variance. Add +10% sensitivity band in cost sheet.

Leila: I'll open a runbook PR and add paging rules. Ops oncall should be able to flip `smoothing.freeze=true` from console.

Maya: OK. If we converge here, I'll book 30-min sync Wed 10am PT to finalize thresholds. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
